metadata.description: Plugins and MCP servers for AI agents from Ayers Electronics.

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: A TL;DR band above the prompt that lists what the agent is waiting on you for, plus /cards, a pane of card games to play while it works.

plugins.name: letterstream-mail
plugins.description: Mail a letter by Certified Mail through LetterStream from Claude Code, with approval gates for the letter and the total.

plugins.name: lancelot
plugins.description: Answers search and retrieval queries against a local LanceDB database, using OpenAI embeddings when an API key is set and text search otherwise.
